Introduction

Ma Jing Xiang is a Chinese singer and member of the project boy group CLOSE YOUR EYES under UNCORE. He made his official debut on April 2, 2025 with the group's mini album "Eternalt".

Prior to debuting, he participated in Boys Planet (2022–2023), where he was selected as one of the 'Shiny Boys' by other trainees and ranked 30th before being eliminated in episode 8. In 2024, he competed in JTBC's PROJECT7, placing 1st and debuting as a member of CLOSE YOUR EYES.

Besides his survival show activities, he was a former member of the pre-debut Chinese group Midsummer Cubs.
